_comment: Targets that MUST appear in any preservation manifest for this estate, with the counts established by read-only inspection on 2026-08-09. Rule P5 fails a manifest that omits one, records it as missing, or records a count that disagrees. These are the artifacts with no recovery path other than a copy that does not yet exist.

Straumvakt-parked.why: OpenADR and dynamic-grid research; not a git worktree, so there is no remote, no branch and no reflog - it exists in exactly one place
